artifact_says: 1) Synthesis of 2-chloro-6-methylsulfonyltoluene ... 2-Chlorotoluene, the catalyst anhydrous aluminium trichloride and solvent are charged into a reaction flask; methanesulfonyl chloride is added dropwise at 0℃-15℃ (see notes on the sign); when the dropwise addition is complete the temperature is raised to room temperature and the reaction is continued; the reaction is followed by LC until it is complete; the reaction mixture is poured into ice water, extracted with solvent and concentrated to give 2-chloro-6-methylsulfonyltoluene; ... According to the above scheme, in step 1) the molar ratio of 2-chlorotoluene, the catalyst anhydrous aluminium trichloride, and methanesulfonyl chloride is 1:1-3:1-2, and said solvent is dichloromethane, chloroform or 1,2-dichloroethane.
